description: Skill-only plugin for curating CodeRabbit learnings CSV exports into reviewable, scoped, de-duplicated drafts.

defaultPrompt: Show merged learnings with source rules.
interface.longDescription: Packages the GINA workflow for reviewing CodeRabbit learnings exports: importing the raw CSV into git, indexing source rules, merging similar rules, scoping reusable learnings, removing one-off rules, documenting superseded decisions, and validating the curated CSV.

name: gina-coderabbit-learnings-curator
